notes.title: Game Update #2: Big update
notes.notes:
New Earth Scene

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715846/a1bec339d3de48ce8779623f3641c1020959c7a8.jpg

A totally new scene has been added to the game, It's a small island on the sea, hope you guys can enjoy the feeling of watching stars on a quiet sea-side night.

Detail information about star

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715846/0e3b44df41c22934fa4f26a9af46fedf612e9086.jpg

The detail information about every star has been added to the game, now you can check the name, the radius, the distance, and even interesting story behind each star.

Steam Achievements and Trading Cards

We setup several interesting Steam Achievements for you, hope you can enjoy it.

We all love Steam Trading Cards, so we also add this to our game.

More Improvements


New textures for skybox, now the sky looks better
Improved line effect in the constellation, it looks more fantastic
Performance Optimization, it's more smooth now
We add some audio to some stars, now you can hear the star's voice
We also add a easter egg in the game

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715846/0a53da39f3882a04adfdda279a70c523e0453108.jpg

The black object near Jupiter, do you know what it is ? ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Game Update #1
notes.notes:
First of all, Thank you all for supporting us on this game ːsteamhappyː, I hope you can enjoy this VR game! We will keep updating this game until it's perfect enough to leave EA!

This week we add two new cool features on this game, WOW !, here they are:

1.New solar system

Now you are just standing on the platform of solar system, around with the sun, the moon and eight planets. For good performance, the planet's size is similar to the real data, not exactly same to the real data. For example, in fact the sun is 100 times bigger than the earth, you can get the similar feeling in the game, but it's not exactlly 100 times.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715846/686e74fc7781bbc504597e2fcb2264153227ac5c.jpg

The revolution and auto rotation are also included, the planets are all high-quality models, you can take a close look at them.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715846/0b128f4c50d0172eb3226ad1fa3938f9698fe3bf.jpg


2.Teleport with your controller

Now the other controller is useful, you can teleport anywhere on the platform of solar system.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715846/2df9a15af80c927b67a994871059444fe699372a.jpg

We also fixed the bug about pause button. in some cases, the button didn't work well, now it's ok.

We are also trying to optimizing the game to make it more smooth, we are still working on this.

If you guys have any advise or meet any bug, please tell us, we need your help.

Thank you ! we will keep you updated !
